北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感-2℃，北风3级，穿厚点，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -2℃ with a level 3 northerly wind. Bundle up to stay warm!

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云13℃，体感8℃，风大注意防风保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy 13℃, feels like 8℃. Strong winds, stay warm and protected.

上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云12℃，体感10℃。微风习习，心情也要美美的。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy 12℃, feels like 10℃. Light breeze, enjoy your beautiful day!

广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州22℃，体感21℃。温暖宜人，穿衣别太多哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is 22℃, feels like 21℃. Pleasant and warm, dress comfortably.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳22℃，体感22℃。天气真好，记得多喝水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is 22℃, feels like 22℃. Lovely weather, remember to stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，12℃。出门记得戴口罩，保护呼吸道！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has haze, 12℃. Remember to wear a mask outdoors to protect your respiratory system!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云12℃，体感7℃。风力4级，注意添衣防风。

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天11℃，湿度78%。空气湿润，体感舒适。

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，15℃。温馨提醒：注意防护，健康最重要！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, 15℃. Gentle reminder: protect yourself, health is most important!

重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆小雨10℃，体感8℃。湿度92%，记得带伞防湿冷。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has light rain 10℃, feels like 8℃. High humidity, remember to bring an umbrella to avoid the damp cold.

哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy -1℃, feels like -8℃. Windy and cold, be sure to dress very warmly.
